description: This header defines the interface for a device communication watchdog module, including function declarations for initializing, terminating, monitoring, or forcing communication failure for devices identified by UUIDs. It includes callback type definitions for communication failure and restoration events, as well as functions to adjust monitoring intervals and query device-specific timeouts.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogInit
methods.description: Initializes the device communication watchdog with callbacks for failure and restoration events.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogSetMonitorInterval
methods.description: Adjusts the monitoring interval for the watchdog, mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogMonitorDevice
methods.description: Starts monitoring a device specified by UUID, with a timeout for communication failure detection.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogStopMonitoringDevice
methods.description: Stops monitoring the device identified by UUID.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogPetDevice
methods.description: Resets or pings the watchdog timer for the specified device.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogForceDeviceInCommFail
methods.description: Forces the device into a communication failure state for testing.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogGetRemainingCommFailTimeoutForLPM
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining communication failure timeout for a device, possibly for Low Power Mode considerations.

methods.name: deviceCommunicationWatchdogResetTimeoutForDevice
methods.description: Resets the communication failure timeout for a specified device.
